Problem Statement:
Given a string S of length N,rearrange the letters in the string to form a new string X which is lexicographically greater than current string(If many answers are possible,output lexicographically smallest one).If no string exists print '-1'.Input Size: 1<=N<=100000 
Input Description:
You are given a string S of length N 
Output Description:
A new string X which is lexicographically greater than current string 
Explanation:
In lexicographical order abdc is greater than abcd and it comes just after abcd 
Sample Input:
abcd 
Sample Output:
abdc
